continuity.narrative_arc: Nanda sees Putana fallen; her respectful cremation and fragrant smoke lead to Krishna’s boon; Gokula flourishes and delights in the child, ending with Yashoda’s maternal care.
continuity.krishna_form_contract: Believable two-armed infant with exactly two arms and two legs, flat matte deep indigo skin, rounded face, short dark curls, muted yellow wrap and one small peacock feather. Match the provisional v004 identity anchor; no adult body transfer or four-armed form.
continuity.supporting_character_status: Follow existing infant-krishna, nandagopan, yashoda, gopikas, gopas and putana contracts. Nanda and Yashoda use provisional shared D042–D044 cues only; references are not approved masters. Use D040 Putana contract for continuous identity, covered fallen body and connected anatomy. Do not invent Bhattathiri in story scenes.
continuity.palette_arc: Full-bleed South Indian temple mural with firm dark contours and flat opaque mineral matte fields: burnt sienna, earth ochre, deep maroon, warm cream, muted olive, deep indigo reserved for Krishna. Painted ochre ornament only; no gloss, metallic gold, frame or text.
